Overview

Strumica is a city in Southeastern with a population of 35,000. A city in southeastern North Macedonia near the Bulgarian border, known for its thermal spas, the Strumica Carnival, and the Belasica mountain range. Housing is more affordable than the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. Reported crime rates are relatively low.
